To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CB1 blockade by the CB1 antagonist AM251 in rats fed a high carbohydrate diet potentiates the down-regulation of lipogenic gene expression in perirenal adipocytes.
CB1 blockade potentiates the down-regulation of lipogenic gene expression in PrAT of high carbohydrate diet-induced obese rats.

CB1 blockade by means of AM251 potentiates the down-regulation of gene expression of lipogenic transcriptional factors in the perirenalis adipose tissue of high-carbohydrate, high-fat diet-fed rats, and that this effect is mediated, at least in part, by the down-regulation in the gene expression levels of the lipogenic enzymes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of CB-1 in the down-regulation of gene expression in PrAT, particularly in HCHD obesity.
the contribution of CB1 to diet-induced obesity in the PrAT.
the role of CB-1 in PrAT and its contribution to the regulation of lipogenesis in HCHD and HFD-induced obesity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in PrAT, CB1 blockade in HCHD-obese rats potentiates down-regulation of lipogenic gene expression.
in HCHD, the CB1 blockade potentiates the down-regulation of gene expression of lipogenic transcription factor and their target enzymes in PrAT.
in the HCHD-induced obese rat, the down-regulation of Srebf- and ChREBP-mediated lipogenesis in PrAt is potentiated by the inhibition of the CB1-mediated pathway.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CB1-mediated signalling in adipose tissue contributes to lipogenesis in obesity induced by HFD but not by HCHD.

CB1 blockade in HCHD-obese rats is able to potentiate the down-regulation of lipogenesis in adipose tissue by inducing the down-regulation in the gene expression and the activity of lipogenic transcriptional factors.
CB1 blockade potentiates down-regulation of lipogenic gene expression in perirenal adipocyte tissue in high carbohydrate diet-induced obesity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the down-regulation of lipogenic gene expression in PrAT of HCHD-induced obese rats may be potentiated by CB1 blockade.
CB1 blockade in HCHD-obese animals may help to further reduce lipogenesis in the PrAT, thus preventing fat deposition in this depot.
the CB1 receptor plays a role in regulating the lipogenic gene expression in PrAT in HCHD diet-induced obesity.
